watches.description: This bracelet boasts an original design and constructed with a perfect harmony of interplay between brushed and polished stainless steel links connected by a signed butterfly clasp to match the similar finishing of the Horizon watches. A high level finishing is also evident with the beveled edges on each link making this bracelet a must-have companion for the watches.
